mapper.select: SELECT id, floor_plan_id, created_by, current_version_id, title, description, created_at FROM layouts WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, image_url, width, height FROM floor_plans WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, layout_id, version, parent_version_id, status, optimistic_lock, created_at FROM layout_versions WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, layout_version_id, name, start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y FROM facilities WHERE layout_version_id = #{layoutVersionId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, layout_version_id, text, x, y FROM layout_texts WHERE layout_version_id = #{layoutVersionId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO floor_plans (name, image_url, width, height) VALUES (#{name}, #{imageUrl}, #{width}, #{height})
INSERT INTO layouts (floor_plan_id, created_by, title, description) VALUES (#{floorPlanId}, #{createdBy}, #{title}, #{description})
INSERT INTO layout_versions (layout_id, version, parent_version_id, status, optimistic_lock) VALUES (#{layoutId}, #{version}, #{parentVersionId}, #{status}, #{optimisticLock})

INSERT INTO facilities (layout_version_id, name, start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y) VALUES
(#{facility.layoutVersionId}, #{facility.name}, #{facility.startX}, #{facility.startY}, #{facility.endX}, #{facility.endY})

INSERT INTO layout_texts (layout_version_id, text, x, y) VALUES
(#{layoutText.layoutVersionId}, #{layoutText.text}, #{layoutText.x}, #{layoutText.y})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM simulations s JOIN layout_versions lv ON s.layout_version_id = lv.id WHERE lv.layout_id = #{layoutId}
